1.content:
# Dynatrace MCP Server Usage
Monitors DQL executions originating from the Dynatrace MCP server (`dynatrace-mcp.execute-dql`).

2.title: Total Executions
2.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter client.source == "dynatrace-mcp.execute-dql"
| summarize total_executions = count()

3.title: Total Scanned Bytes
3.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter client.source == "dynatrace-mcp.execute-dql"
| summarize total_scanned_bytes = sum(scanned_bytes)

4.title: Unique Users
4.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter client.source == "dynatrace-mcp.execute-dql"
| summarize unique_users = countDistinct(user.email)

5.title: Executions Over Time
5.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter client.source == "dynatrace-mcp.execute-dql"
| makeTimeseries executions = count()

6.title: Scanned Bytes Over Time
6.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter client.source == "dynatrace-mcp.execute-dql"
| makeTimeseries scanned_bytes_total = sum(scanned_bytes)

7.title: Executions by Table
7.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter client.source == "dynatrace-mcp.execute-dql"
| summarize executions = count(), by: {table}
| sort executions desc
| limit 20

8.title: Top 10 Users
8.query:
fetch dt.system.events
| filter client.source == "dynatrace-mcp.execute-dql"
| summarize executions = count(), by: {user.email}
| sort executions desc
| limit 10
